name: HOLLOW SKIN: Geneware Identity Sim
description: An indie neural sim from a collective of Tier 2 geneware artists, HOLLOW SKIN places players in fully realized bodies that are not their own — different genetic modifications, different sensory profiles, different chronic pain thresholds — and tasks them with navigating a single week of social and economic life in GLMZ. No combat, no objectives beyond survival and social navigation, the game became a phenomenon among geneware communities and disability advocates for its unflinching commitment to embodied difference. The developers refused a buyout from OmniPath Biotech and continued releasing expansions independently.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corponation HR director secretly plays HOLLOW SKIN in a Tier 1 body every weekend — and is slowly being radicalized by the experience.
One of the 'fictional' bodies in the sim is discovered to be an exact neural copy of a missing Tier 2 geneware artist.
An expansion pack is quietly pulled after players report the simulated body they were assigned kept experiencing memories that weren't in the game's code.
